title: Bohot andhera hai
body:
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI ×2
YE GHAR HAI QABR SE BADTAR BAHOT ANDHETA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR..........
PASAND KAR LIYA BHAI NE KIS TARHA YE MAKAN ×2
RAHUNGI IS ME MAI KYU KAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR……….
MERE WATAN ME TO AYESE MAKAN NAHI HOTE ×2
YAHAN MAKANO KE ANDAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR………...
YAHAN SE AOR KAHIN MUJHKO LE CHALO AMMA ×2
KI MAR NA JAUN MAI GHUT KAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR……….
GHUROOB HO GAYA SURAJ WO RAHI HAI AZAN ×2
CHARAGH RAKH DO JALA KAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR………..
SULANE SINE PE BABA ZARUR AYENGEN ×2
CHALE NA JAYE WO AA KAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR………..
PIDAR KE PAS HI JANGAL ME SOIYO BHAIYA ×2
YHAN NA AYIO ASGHAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAETI THI MADAR……….
CHACHA NA MANGUNGI PANI TUMHARE SAR KI QASAM ×2
UTHA LO GOD ME AA KAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR………..
TADAP KE MAR GAYI BACHHI JO QAID KHANE ME ×2
SADA YE ATI HAI AKSAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR……….
CHARAGHE MATAME SHAIH SATH LAIYO “AKBAR” ×2
SUNA HAI QABR KE ANDAR BAHOT ANDHERA HAI
SAKINA KAHETI THI MADAR…………
